subject: HealthSecure – Private VPC / OnPrem discovery (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Linda Park <linda.park@healthsecure.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: HealthSecure – Private VPC / OnPrem discovery (post-call recap)

Thanks again for a productive call this morning — appreciate the time, Linda and Raj. Per our discussion, below is a short recap, the key pain points you shared, and proposed next steps.

Summary of goals
- Primary driver: keep PHI inside HealthSecure-controlled network for regulatory reasons (data residency + auditability).
- Target use case: clinical note summarization and triage assistance within provider workflows (low latency, high P95 performance).
- Deployment preference: Private VPC (preferred) or fully on-prem/air-gapped if VPC peering isn’t possible.

Top pain points / constraints noted
- No outbound internet egress from model-serving hosts; all model images and updates must be pulled by HealthSecure from a secure repository (air-gap option).
- KMS requirement: customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for encryption of model payloads and logs.
- Network: VPC peering or Transit Gateway connectivity with strict ACLs and limited allowed subnets.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 + pen test summary required for procurement.
- Ops: need audit logs for model access and a clear retention policy for tokens and prompts.

What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Private Deployment with customer-managed VPC and optional on-prem air-gap packaging.
- Integration points: support for external KMS (KMIP/HSM integrations) and on-host encryption.
- Auditability: request/response logging, token-level cost/latency dashboards, and configurable retention windows.

Action items / next steps
1) HealthSecure to share: network diagram (VPC subnets, NAT/GW, firewall rules), procurement contact, and any internal checklist for air-gapped installs. (Raj — can you share?)
2) Redwood to share: filled security questionnaire (attached), draft deployment architecture, and a short pre-call checklist for the technical deep-dive.
3) Schedule technical deep-dive with your infra team to walk through peering, routing, and KMS details (we suggested 2/23 or 2/24 below).
4) Procurement: confirm required evidence (SOC 2 PDF, data processing addendum) and timeline for POs/NDA.

Attachments: HealthSecure-Security-Questionnaire-filled.pdf, PrivateDeployment-architecture-draft.pdf

Would love to confirm a time for the tech deep-dive — I’m copying Alex (infra lead) and Marissa (CS/solutions) to coordinate.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthsecure.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Linda Park <linda.park@healthsecure.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthsecure.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSecure – Private VPC / OnPrem discovery (post-call recap)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming we’re aligned on the goals. I attached our current network diagram and an internal checklist to help scope the air-gap option.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Network diagram attached: shows VPC subnets, NAT gateways, Transit Gateway peering candidate account IDs.
- Procurement contact: procurement@healthsecure.com (CC'd). They will need SOC 2 and a DPA before signing.
- Timeline: procurement is aiming for a decision by end of March; technical acceptance testing likely mid-April if we proceed.

We can do a deep-dive Tuesday 2/23 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works for your infra team, please send the meeting invite.

Attachments: HealthSecure-VPC-Diagram.pdf, HS-Airgap-Checklist.docx

—Raj
Director, Infrastructure
HealthSecure
raj.patel@healthsecure.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthsecure.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthSecure – Private VPC / OnPrem discovery (post-call recap)

Thanks Raj — 10:00 AM PT on 2/23 works for me. A couple of things we'd like to cover in the technical deep-dive so we come prepared:
- KMS integration: can you confirm if your keys are in an HSM with KMIP or AWS KMS customer-managed keys? If AWS CMK, please share the account ID and any cross-account roles we'll need.
- Egress policy: confirm that model-serving hosts cannot initiate outbound HTTPS. If so, we'll bring an air-gap install plan and a secure pull process.
- Image delivery: do you have an internal artifact repo (Artifactory/Harbor) or will you prefer a signed image bundle we provide for offline import?
- Audit retention: expected retention window for request logs (30/90/365 days?).

I'll attach a short checklist and our draft architecture for the deep-dive. Please share the network diagram and any firewall rules ahead of the call.

Meeting invite incoming from Camila.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com

From: Procurement Team <procurement@healthsecure.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@healthsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: HealthSecure – Private VPC / OnPrem discovery (post-call recap)

Marissa / Camila — looping in procurement for the contract and compliance checklist. A couple of items we need to proceed:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and pen test summary.
2) Draft DPA with data residency language limiting processing to our US VPCs.
3) High-level SOW and estimated monthly committed capacity / pricing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a signed image bundle for air-gapped installs and a standard NDA? Also confirm whether you can accept our standard PO terms (Net 60) or if you need Net 30.

Thanks — procurement@healthsecure.com
HealthSecure Procurement
